metadata.title: North Carolina Banking & Startup Opportunity Atlas
metadata.yearConvention: The interface selects BDS label year t. BDS flows span March t−1 to March t; the frozen June t−1 banking snapshot falls inside that interval and is label-aligned rather than a clean lag.
metadata.timingNote: Model A4 uses the June t−2 banking snapshot and t−2 controls, which precede the March t−1 start of the BDS interval. It also drops the first outcome year, changing both timing and sample.
metadata.missingPolicy: Disclosure-suppressed BDS startup cells remain null and are never converted to zero.

models.timingConclusion: The frozen and clean-preperiod estimates are both imprecise and have opposite signs; the data do not establish a precise, temporally stable sign.

branchDensity.label: Full-service branch density
branchDensity.timing: June 30 labeled t−1; this date falls inside the BDS March-to-March outcome interval

startupRate.label: Employer-startup rate
startupRate.unit: age-zero establishments per 1,000 lagged active establishments
startupRate.timing: BDS label year t; flows span March t−1 to March t

startupJobs.label: Startup-job creation intensity
startupJobs.timing: BDS label year t; flows span March t−1 to March t
